newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian bank teller guns down bandit.
newsitem.headline: Russian bank teller guns down bandit.

text.p: A Russian woman bank teller turned the tables on an armed robber by shooting him dead after he demanded the bank's money, police said on Wednesday.

The cool-headed teller at Sberbank in Vladimir, 170 km (110 miles) northeast of Moscow, pumped four bullets into the man during the robbery on Tuesday, prompting his two accomplices to flee, police said. Officials later detained both men.
"Because most Sberbank tellers are women, of course they all need to be armed with guns," said police spokesman German Isayev. "She used the weapon according to the rules."
Sberbank is a traditionally staid national chain, dating back to Soviet days where Russians keep their savings, pay their gas bills and send in rent for state-owned apartments.
